Generated Narrative: CodeSystem disaster-relation-cs

This case-sensitive code system http://fhir-fli.dev/bumblebee/CodeSystem/disaster-relation-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
directly Directly caused by the disasterInjury caused by the earthquake, typhoon, tsunami, eruption; drowning; burn.
indirectly Indirectly causedIllness or injury from the post-disaster environment, or a chronic condition that worsened because the disaster cut off access to care.
not-related Not caused by the disasterA health problem the disaster did not cause and which is not urgent.
unknown Not knownNobody has said. This is the default and it is allowed to stay.
